title: Privacy & GDPR
description: Data subject requests, retention periods, consent records and the VERBİS inventory. Every action is written to the audit log.
forbidden: You don't have permission to manage privacy settings.
load_failed: Privacy data could not be loaded. Refresh the page and try again.
contact_search: Search by name, email or phone
new_request.title: New data subject request
new_request.description: Handle KVKK art. 11 / GDPR art. 15 and 17 requests here. Requests run in the background; track their status in the list below.
kind.export_hint: The contact's conversations, messages, attachments, AI records and consent history are collected into a ZIP file. The link is valid for 7 days.
kind.erase_hint: The contact's identity and content are permanently deleted or anonymized. This cannot be undone.
erase.title: Permanently erase personal data?
erase.description: You are about to carry out the data subject's right to erasure.
erase.scope: The contact's name, contact details, channel identities, conversation and message content, attachments and AI records are deleted or anonymized. The contact is blocked and no new consent can be recorded.
erase.ack: I confirm the erasure request was verified and understand the data cannot be recovered.
requests_description: Every data subject request in your organization, with who started it and when it completed.
requests_empty_description: Exports and erasures you start for a contact appear here.
download_failed: The file could not be downloaded. Try again.
retention.title: Retention periods
retention.description: Automatically delete or anonymize data once it expires. Categories that are off are kept indefinitely.
retention.conversations_hint: Counted from the closing date; message content and contact details are cleared.
retention.attachments_hint: Counted from upload; files are removed from storage.
retention.ai_logs_hint: Input, output and tool call content is cleared; costs and counters are kept.
retention.anonymize_hint: Anonymization clears personal content and keeps the record skeleton for statistics and reports.
retention.delete_warning: Delete removes content permanently and hides it from reports too. This cannot be undone.
retention.schedule_hint: Rules are applied nightly in the background.
consents.title: Consent records
consents.description: Record which privacy notice version a contact consented to, or withdrew from, for which purpose. Records cannot be changed.
consents.pick_contact: Select a contact to see their consent history.
consents.record_description: A new consent record is created for {{name}}.
consents.source_hint: Where consent was collected; e.g. panel, web form, call center.
consents.empty_description: No consent has been recorded for this contact yet.
inventory.title: VERBİS processing inventory
inventory.description: Draft inventory of the personal data categories processed in ClickFix. Download it as the basis of your VERBİS registration and complete it.
toast.export_queued: Export started. Download it from the list when it is ready.
validation.days: Enter a number of days between 1 and 36500.
